name: reverses three-node list
call: (function() { var n1 = new Node(1, new Node(2, new Node(3))); var r = reverse(n1); return r.value === 3 && r.next.value === 2 && r.next.next.value === 1 && r.next.next.next === null; })()

name: single node
call: (function() { var n = new Node(42); var r = reverse(n); return r.value === 42 && r.next === null; })()

name: two nodes
call: (function() { var n = new Node('a', new Node('b')); var r = reverse(n); return r.value === 'b' && r.next.value === 'a' && r.next.next === null; })()
